S4 E2 — The Black Widows
Two seemingly elderly California women befriend homeless men, then kill them to collect insurance money.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Gamble
A young inmate with a big personality faces problems while four other inmates are in jail after a shocking home invasion robbery and rape; one defendant will stand apart from the others, though nothing will prepare him for what's to come.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — The Hamptons
In Kent County Jail, a well-known inmate is back with more than 130 prior stays; an inside look at life in the one wing of the jail that inmates consider prime real estate, but where one will be expelled for good.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Jail Born
A night at the beach in his brother's truck sends a repeat offender back to jail; a Christmas morning hold-up leaves a young man dead and four people in jail with serious charges.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — He Takes No Prisoners
Grant Culliver, warden of one of Alabama's toughest prisons, Holman Correctional Facility, doesn't miss a beat in getting into a disruptive inmate's face, but he's also compassionate and gentle when the situation calls for it.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Snake and Fluffy
Of the nearly 1,000 inmates at Holman, the 200 most dangerous must be segregated from the rest; Bobby Gilbert, or "Snake.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Defending Bacon
At Wichita's Sedgwick County Jail an inmate launches an attack on another, sending him to the emergency room; a detective must get to the bottom of it, while a pastor hopes to get to the heart of it.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Lifestyle
Wichita, Kansas and surrounding Sedgwick County take pride in their Wild West roots, but Billy the Kid's gang would be seriously outgunned by the notorious gangs of modern day Wichita.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E4 — The Boy Toy Killer
When a wealthy Texas retiree is found dead in a ravine in Mexico, all eyes turn to his young boyfriend, a porn actor; while investigators uncover the truth behind their relationship, border crossing records provide the key to solving the case.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E5 — Psychic Fiend's Network
A phony psychic scams a wealthy but lonely timber baron out of millions while her devious daughter pretends to be in love with him.

title: Lockup: San Quentin: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — The Gang's All Here
As the oldest prison in California, San Quentin is steeped in a violent history, so it has a set of regulations and procedures to maintain order; inmates often operate under a different code of conduct; gangs control "prison politics.".

title: Lockup: San Quentin: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Conjugal Visit
San Quentin's warden says that other than an inmate's release date, visits are the most important things in their lives; for some, visits are rare moments of intimacy; for others, they are business transaction opportunities.

title: Lockup: San Quentin: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Weapons 101
San Quentin has one of the longest histories of violence; whether it's an inmate fresh off the street, a gang dropout in protective custody, or an officer trying to maintain order, they've all fallen victim to violent attacks.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — On Broadway
In Wichita, Kansas, a young woman says she stabbed a man in self-defense; a skinhead with a violent past leaves his girlfriend battered and bruised.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Citizen's Arrest
A convicted thief continues his stealing ways inside the jail; a former law enforcement officer turned meth addict serves time with and grows closer to her dealer; a man gets arrested for allegedly threatening the sheriff.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E8 — Dues and Don'ts
In prison, as on the outside, a single decision can change a person's life forever; inmates make all kinds of fateful choices, but behind bars, there is no escaping the consequences of one's actions.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S3 E8 — A Private Hell
For some, prison might be hell, and it can be even worse for the sex offenders.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E4 — Pushing the Limits
In a life full of restrictions, we've seen inmates take control of whatever they can, despite the consequences; we've seen frustrated inmates reach their breaking point; in the battle of wills, some will take actions that can never be reversed.
